first.rationale: I currently intend to shorten onboarding because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding to improved time-to-value and early adoption. I also want to verify the promotional-pricing record because competitor pricing is an important alternative, but discounting may improve acquisition without maximizing sustainable qualified revenue. A guarded test should monitor activation, completion, qualified pipeline or revenue, retention proxies, and downstream product usage.
